ABOUT.TITLE: About
ABOUT.PAR_1: I’m Samuele, a Software Engineer. I mainly work with React, Angular, TypeScript, and Node.js, building complete, maintainable web applications from the frontend to the APIs. I enjoy tackling complex problems with a practical approach, starting by understanding the requirements and turning them into clear, well-structured solutions.
ABOUT.PAR_2: My approach starts with understanding the problem. I analyze requirements and constraints, define a clear structure, and turn that understanding into practical solutions, with close attention to architecture, code quality, and user experience. I aim to build solid applications that are easy to understand and designed to evolve over time.
ABOUT.PAR_3: In my work, I apply Software Engineering practices such as data validation, authentication and authorization, testing, API management, containerization, and version control with Git. I mainly work on the frontend, while also considering the application as a whole and paying attention to how its different layers interact, from data management to the final user experience.
ABOUT.PAR_4: My goal is to contribute to projects where technical reasoning, autonomy, and attention to detail matter, approaching each problem pragmatically, from defining requirements to delivering the solution. Take a look at my projects on GitHub, which I update regularly, to see how I work and what I build.
